[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift

The deficit deadlift has you stand on a plate so you start from a slightly lower position, which makes your hamstrings and glutes work harder off the floor and builds strength right where the pull is hardest. Keep the bar close to your body and drive your hips and shoulders up together. Reps drop from the last deficit week, so aim to add weight while you hold your positions.
"}]
